tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search job listings published on Level (jobsbylevel.com), an AI job board that rates every listing by how central AI is to the role, from Little AI (AI Level 1) to Builds AI (AI Level 4). Filters: free-text query, AI level range, remote, city, company, posting age, visa sponsorship, minimum yearly s

tools.name: latest_ai_jobs
tools.description: The newest AI jobs published on Level (jobsbylevel.com): listings rated Works on AI (AI Level 3) or Builds AI (AI Level 4), posted in the last 24 hours by default, newest first. Level checks employer career sites every hour. Optional filters: free text, remote, visa sponsorship, minimum yearly salar

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Returns the full detail of a job listing published on Level, by its UUID or its slug (e.g. "senior-ml-engineer-acme-corp"). Includes recently expired listings, like the public page. Never returns a direct link to the employer's ATS: use the returned `url` (the canonical jobsbylevel.com page) to appl

tools.name: market_stats
tools.description: Aggregated statistics over currently published Level listings: distribution by AI level (AI Level 1 to AI Level 4), share of remote roles, and the most frequent tools and categories. Computed directly from the database, not an estimate.

tools.name: list_companies_by_ai_level
tools.description: Ranks companies currently hiring on Level by how central AI is to their open roles: the average AI rating (0-100) of their live listings. tools.name: salary_stats
tools.description: Salary statistics over the live Level listings that publish a yearly salary range: number of listings, median, 25th and 75th percentile of the middle of each range, in one currency at a time (default USD, currencies are never mixed). Hourly and monthly rates are excluded. Optional filters: keyword i

tools.name: top_hiring_companies
tools.description: The 10 companies with the most live AI jobs posted in the last N days on Level: listings rated Works on AI (AI Level 3) or Builds AI (AI Level 4). tools.name: get_level_definitions
tools.description: Returns the definition of Level's four AI-impact levels (AI Level 1 to AI Level 4), the scale every job listing on jobsbylevel.com is rated against.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job · Private data: market_stats, salary_stats · Public sink: market_stats, salary_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job · Private data: market_stats, salary_stats · Public sink: market_stats, salary_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
